definitions.explanation: Formal expression of gratitude for ongoing business or social support from a customer, client, or benefactor. Used in business letters, opening remarks, and shop signage.

examples.japanese: お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I sincerely thank you for your many years of patronage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど、⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We respectfully ask for your continued patronage in the future as well.

notes:
Noun form of {引|ひ}き{立|た}てる (to support, promote, favor). Almost always appears with the honorific お and refers to support extended by a customer or superior. Common on signs and in stock business phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}る→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧: to receive your patronage (very formal)
- お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど: (formal closing softener)
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て: many years of patronage
- お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧: to be grateful for your support

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご{愛顧|あいこ}: your patronage — slightly more elevated, common in retail and service
- ご⟦{高配|こうはい}→高配：27410_kouhai⟧: your kind consideration — even more formal, used in correspondence
- ご⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: your support — broader and less stiff
